movie.title: I Live Here Now
movie.overview: A woman finds herself trapped in a remote hotel where the violent echoes of her past come alive, blurring the lines between her darkest nightmares and the waking world.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Trapped in an isolated hotel, a woman must face the violent, recurring specters of her past as her reality fractures into a living nightmare.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A tormented woman arrives at a remote, secluded hotel hoping to escape her troubled history, only to find the sanctuary turning into a prison. Dark echoes of her past violent trauma materialize within the corridors, forcing her to confront forgotten memories. As the boundaries between her waking life and horrific nightmares dissolve, she faces a desperate struggle for survival. She must decipher whether the haunting forces are real or driven by her own unraveling psyche.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Seeking refuge from a fraught past, a troubled woman checks into a quiet, isolated hotel located far from civilization. What begins as a peaceful retreat quickly devolves into terror when uncanny, violent manifestations begin to disrupt her stay. Surreal encounters and phantom-like occurrences replay the worst memories of her previous relationships and trauma, blurring her perception of space and time. Trapped within the sprawling, maze-like building, she attempts to find an exit, only to discover every corridor leads her deeper into her own subconscious guilt. The hotel itself seems to feed on her fear, altering its layout and twisting her sensory reality until she can no longer trust her own senses. Paranoid and exhausted, she encounters lingering representations of her abusers and past mistakes, forcing her to relived her darkest moments. To survive the night, she must actively unravel the secrets buried within her memories rather than running from them. Ultimately, her fight for physical escape mirrors an internal battle to reclaim her agency from the horrors that have long haunted her.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: I Live Here Now is a psychological horror thriller following a woman who seeks refuge at a remote hotel to escape her past. Instead of finding peace, she becomes trapped in a harrowing realm where violent memories manifest in the real world, forcing her to navigate a haunting maze of personal trauma and psychological terror.

story_structure.climax: A harrowing confrontation takes place where the darkest shadow of her past directly threatens to consume her permanently within the physical space of the hotel.
story_structure.conflict: Strange, violent occurrences begin manifesting inside the hotel, gradually revealing themselves as uncanny physical manifestations of her traumatic past.
story_structure.resolution: The immediate threat subsides, forcing her to reckon with the remaining aftermath of her trauma and come to terms with her new reality.
story_structure.introduction: A woman arrives at an isolated, remote hotel, attempting to find refuge or start fresh away from her troubled history.
story_structure.risingAction: As the line between her nightmare visions and reality completely dissolves, she must navigate the increasingly hostile hotel while confronting the traumatic memories she tried to suppress.
